text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Man… I'm sooo bored! I'm so bored I could just float away…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, I might as well go for a fly!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All right, gotta take wing while the current's rising! Time to get ready!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Let's see… I'm a self-powered entity already, so I just need wings, some snacks, and―

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah. I've got training today…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, whatever! I'm not feeling it, so hooky it is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's how Gold Ship literally prioritized having her head in the clouds over her own training…
